scope: Four sequential source runs in 1024/512/512/1024 order. Same retained default-world source, camera route and render settings. Rolling recorder off; bounded collision-stage diagnostic on. Continuous post-draw intervals, screenshot phases excluded. Physics monitor is an engine monitor, not per-tick elapsed work. Async resident sets vary, so frame and total-work differences are not an isolated causal estimate. Short checks do not qualify movement, edits, endurance or stable 60 FPS.
decision: Keep production 1024; no consistent whole-frame benefit, varying residency, more shapes. Do not treat this diagnostic as stable 60 FPS or contact qualification.
review_scope: Eight final arrival/end-outdoor images inspected: no obvious missing terrain, building frontage, road, cover, trees, boulders or held tool. Intermediate images retained but unreviewed; no continuous motion or world-design approval.
attachment_scope: Loading and gameplay stage samples include all attachments; this integrated listener does not classify cold versus reused shapes. The separate attachment microbenchmark does.
